Krystal Integrated Services in Sion feels more like a functional office than anything polished, but the process is fairly organized with separate counters for documentation, ID card, banking, and gate pass work. Seating is available and the setup seems manageable for basic office visits, though the overall space can feel a bit plain and crowded depending on timing.

featured_reviews.name: Prashanth Jagajivan Ram
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience with the security services provided by Krystal at Coimbatore Medical College Hospital, Tamil Nadu.

My wife underwent a C-section on 13/04/2026 and is admitted on the 1st floor (65th Block). On 18/04/2026, we were stopped by security when trying to go to the same floor, even though attendants are normally allowed.

Despite clearly explaining our situation, the guard did not listen for nearly 15 minutes and kept blocking us. Meanwhile, another person simply said “1st floor” and was allowed immediately. Only after I raised my voice out of frustration did the guard finally listen and allow us.

This raises a serious concern — why are security staff not listening properly to genuine reasons and acting consistently?

The behavior was inhuman, unprofessional, and showed a complete lack of empathy. Such conduct is unacceptable, especially in a hospital where families are already under stress.

Immediate action and proper training of staff are required.
